The WyreStorm MX-0404-HDMI is a powerful plug and play matrix switcher, bundled in a small compact chassis for ease of installation. An 18Gbps matrix switcher, it allows up to four 4K sources to be independently routed to four displays. Additionally, each output has the capability to scale 4K content down to connected 1080p displays without affecting 4K sources. Audio following the output can be extracted via the digital 5.1 S/PDIF, allowing it to be sent to an external audio distribution system.
This small, yet robust 18Gbps HDMI switch comes fully equipped to fit in a standard 19” rack space, designed with professional installations in mind.

Bigger isn’t always better. The MX-0404-HDMI was designed with professional installations in mind. Because of its small chassis, the MX-0404-HDMI is a breeze to install, and with the included brackets, it can also be integrated into a standard 1U rack space making the MX-0404-HDMI a robust matrix for its size.

Sporting a pure 18Gbps HDMI backplane, supporting all UHD video signals up to and including 2160p 4:4:4/60, and high frame-rate HDR 12bit 4:2:2 up to 60Hz, along with multichannel audio up to DTS:X and Dolby Atmos.
